gaps.quote: The complex variant's overhead is sublinear.
gaps.note: The page gives one recurrence F(mf) <= (s/W)F(f)+O(1) for both networks, but for the complex layer the overhead is not O(1). The paper (lines 2406-2415) has F(e) <= (s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1), with F(e)=O(e) at leaves e<d^beta, so the overhead grows with e. The page only says it is 'sublinear', which does not support the O(1) term or the unrolled sum.

This holds for the bit-network interchange (paper line 1486, Proposition power-interchange, with O(Ve^tau)). For the complex layer the paper's unrolling (lines 2393-2445) gives a larger exponent lambda' > max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)}, still below 1, because of the K-dependent overhead and the leaf cost. So it is not O(Vf^tau) with the same tau. The page also leaves out the base case F(1)=O(1) that the unrolling needs.
